work.title: Readela 0.2.1: canonical name and store copy, metadata only
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner instruction of 2026-10-06 for the smallest 0.2.1 patch: version 0.2.1; manifest name Readela with short_name unchanged; the manifest description and the shared store description replaced by the owner's wording; verification, reproducible build and hashes; integration through the protected main; a v0.2.1 tag and release; submission of the exact verified artifacts as updates to the existing Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons listings; evidence and managerial reconciliation. It stops at any owner-only provider action (credentials, multi-factor verification, terms, payment).

parentPreflight.reason: That record covers the 0.2.0 release with the presentation Readela by Amir42 and is not edited. This patch is a separately bounded piece of work under DEC-115 and DEC-116, so it carries its own assertion.

inScope: docs/store-listing.md, the Product Brief identity row and the README package names, where they would otherwise contradict the package.
Verification, two clean builds with equal digests, tag v0.2.1 and a release on the frozen commit, and submission of those exact archives as updates to the two existing listings.
outOfScope: Permissions, host matches, stored data, product behaviour, popup, site adapters, dependencies, build system.
New features, new sites, new browsers, new screenshots, a redesigned listing.
The v0.2.0 tag, release and archives.
Capabilities, Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.
